Subject: Ariba onboarding - account creation failing at org verification

Hi Connor,

We started the supplier onboarding flow this morning and keep getting hung up on the organizational verification step in Ariba. After entering our legal name (Greenfield Medical LLC) and tax ID the portal redirects to a page that says 'Organization claim mismatch' and asks us to contact the buyer. Hi Laura — thanks for the screenshot and the heads up. Sorry for the friction here. Short checklist to get this unblocked quickly: 

- Can you attach a PDF of your W-9 or incorporation paperwork showing the exact legal name and EIN? That helps procurement reconcile tax-entity mapping on our side.
- Confirm the email used to receive the Ariba invite (sometimes the system tries to match existing "organization claims" tied to an earlier account).
- If your IT uses an SSO domain different from your legal entity (e.g., greenfieldmed.com vs greenfieldmedical.com), let me know. That can cause the portal to show a different display name.

If you can send the W‑9 now I will loop procurement and our Ariba admin to update the claim mapping. If easier, we can do a 20-min screen share at 11:00 or 14:30 today — which works for you?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
